title: fix(hierarchicalMenu): pass correct attribute name to Insights
body:
When clicking on facets in a `hierarchicalMenu`, the passed `attribute` is always the first one passed in the [`attributes`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/hierarchical-menu/js/#widget-param-attributes) option, no matter what level it actually is.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5370675/193083634-ba433032-135d-4535-abb9-5cf9fbd8a58f.mov

This fixes it by inferring the level based on the `facetName` by splitting on `separator`.

FX-1801
